```{r, echo = FALSE, message=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(message = FALSE, warning=FALSE)
# plotly.js from the CDN, so the site's pages don't each copy it
options(plotly.core.plotlyjs = "cdn")
```
# Dot and Dumbbell Plots

```{r}
library(plotly.core)

s <- read.csv("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/plotly/datasets/master/school_earnings.csv")
s <- s[order(s$Men), ]

s |>
  go_figure() |>
  add_scatter(
    x = ~Women,
    y = ~School,
    name = "Women",
    mode = "markers",
    marker = go_scatter_marker(color = "pink")
  ) |>
  add_scatter(
    x = ~Men,
    y = ~School,
    name = "Men",
    mode = "markers",
    marker = go_scatter_marker(color = "blue")
  ) |>
  update_layout(
    title = "Gender earnings disparity",
    xaxis = go_xaxis(title = "Annual Salary (in thousands)"),
    margin = go_margin(l = 100)
  )
```

#Reference

See `go_scatter()` for more information and chart attribute options!
